text:
A Lake Wind Advisory is in effect, with north winds running 15 to 25 knots on the broad lake and waves 2 to 4 feet, easing later. If you’re staying in town, the day is playing out on the cool, cloudy side, 61 degrees with a north wind at 11 mph and a high near 65. A few models still try to warm us more, but the colder, wetter read has the better look right now.

Expect hit-or-miss showers through the afternoon, with only a small amount of rain, then another chance tonight as clouds hold and temperatures slip toward 52. The lake should settle to 1 to 2 foot waves by late day, but I’d stay off the broad water until the wind backs down. Monday remains gloomy, with showers more likely and a high near 63. Plan on a jacket today, and keep evening walks flexible.

week.blurb: Cloudy and cool near 65 Sunday, with showers possible; the wetter models make rain gear the safer bet.
Cloudy and wet near 63 Monday, with rain showers likely through the day and into the evening.
Mostly cloudy Tuesday, near 64, though a cooler afternoon remains possible.
Partly sunny and milder Wednesday, climbing to around 72 with no rain in the forecast.
Partly sunny and mild Thursday, near 74, with showers possible after dark.
Partly sunny Friday, near 69, with a 40 percent chance of showers.
Mostly sunny and cooler Saturday, near 63, with daytime plans looking dry before a slight evening shower chance.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST (regional station — Burlington relevance only, never their branding): The Nor’easter will continue to weaken on Monday, though the center of it will be closer to our region. Showers will continue, though again mainly south, so it will be a rather gloomy day. The showers will linger into Tuesday morning before the remnants finally move out. Total rainfall from now through early Tuesday morning could exceed 2 inches in southern portions of our region. Northern areas will receive much less, only a quarter inch or less. Due to the recent dry conditions, flooding isn’t expected, and this will actually be a beneficial rain. Tuesday afternoon will be mostly cloudy and cool with highs in the 50s to low 60s. Overnight lows will remain relatively mild though, getting in the 40s and 50s.
